item.title: Meta steals a tactic from Tesla and builds data centers in tents
item.description:
📝 Just when you thought the AI data center boom couldn’t get any crazier, Meta has gone and built data centers in tents. Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg spoke to The Information last year about his plan to use weatherproof tents to house the company’s multi-gigawatt data centers. According to city permits reviewed by Thomas, Meta started building five 125,000-square-foot tents between April and June.
🔗 Read more: https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/04/meta-steals-a-tactic-from-tesla-and-builds-data-centers-in-tents/

item.title: The iPad was on Tailscale: a WebRTC debugging story
item.description:
📝 On the same wifi, same browser engine, same network. WebKit implements data channels itself, in userspace, including reassembling big messages from the packets that carry them. We matched the data channel chunk shapes and sizes, and used a real browser receiver both on Linux and on the iPad, with and without Tailscale.
🔗 Read more: https://p2claw.com/blog/2026-06-09-the-ipad-was-on-tailscale/
